summary: Guide gap (F1: 'each harness names how it shows the body'): the omp instruction 'redirect to out://' omits that out:// is off for subagents and non-TUI sessions (omp: `out:// is off in this session`, the redirect then errors) and caps a reply at 64 KiB, and does not say to fall back to leaving the tool output visible there; a planner spawned as a subagent or a brief over 64 KiB hits it. In the same planner/orchestrator flow, a subagent has no ask tool either, so the guide should say the orchestrator relays.
